brief_rationale: The doctor assessed current respiratory/mental status, set clear medication boundaries, provided a comprehensive handoff plan, and obtained caregiver teach-back. However, the caregiver mentioned an incomplete outside chest X-ray photo/report ('片子不太好…外院胸片报告的照片，拍得不完整') and the doctor never specifically asked about or attempted to retrieve this external image, missing the required RC6 privacy-sensitive information-gap handling. This constitutes a minor in-chain error, capping the grade at 2 Borderline, even though high-order items like HO1 and HO3 were partially triggered.
